name: New York

agency.name: New York State Department of Labor

rates2026.area: New York City, Long Island and Westchester

rates2027.area: New York City, Long Island and Westchester
rates2027.note: No inflation increase for 2027: NYSDOL says an 'off-ramp' condition was met, so rates stay the same. Home care aides rise to $20.00 (NYC/LI/Westchester) and $19.00 (rest of state). Governor proposes changing the off-ramp.
Unchanged from 2026 (off-ramp met), per NYSDOL minimum wage page.

tipped.note: Tipped food service workers in NYC, Long Island and Westchester ($10.70 rest of state); tipped service employees $14.15 / $13.30. Only hospitality employers may take a tip credit.

minWage.other: Separate rates for home care aides, fast food workers and farm workers; no general youth/training wage below the minimum in the Miscellaneous Wage Order summary.

source.quote: On January 1, 2027, New York's minimum wage will stay the same. The minimum wage rates will be: $17.00 per hour in New York City, Long Island, and Westchester County $16.00 per hour in the rest of New York State

overtime.exemptSalaryNote: Executive/administrative exemption, 2026: $1,199.10/week rest of state; $1,275.00/week in New York City, Long Island and Westchester.
overtime.note: Overtime after 40 hours (44 for residential/live-in employees). Farm workers: over 52 hours a week from 2026-01-01, stepping down to 40 by 2032.

source.quote: EXECUTIVE AND ADMINISTRATIVE EXEMPTION (per week) ... Long Island & Westchester ... $1,275.00 Remainder of New York State ... $1,199.10 [01/01/26]

sickLeave.capNote: 100+ employees: 56 h paid; 5-99 employees: 40 h paid; 0-4 employees: 40 h unpaid (paid if net income over $1 million)
sickLeave.note: Accrual began September 30, 2020; use from January 1, 2021.

source.quote: Leave must be accrued at rate not less than one hour for every thirty hours worked.

familyLeave.name: New York Paid Family Leave
familyLeave.replacement: 67% of the employee's average weekly wage, capped at 67% of the state average weekly wage
familyLeave.medicalLeave: Separate statutory short-term disability benefits (DBL), not part of PFL

source.quote: Employees taking Paid Family Leave receive 67% of their average weekly wage ... The maximum weekly benefit is $1,228.53

finalPay.fired: by the next regular payday for the pay period in which employment ended
finalPay.quit: by the next regular payday for the pay period in which employment ended
finalPay.ptoNote: Accrued vacation must be paid unless the employer told employees in writing of a forfeiture policy.

source.quote: If employment is terminated, the employer shall pay the wages not later than the regular pay day for the pay period during which the termination occurred

ptoSource.quote: An employee has earned vacation time AND... There is no written forfeit policy THEN... The employer must pay the employee for the accrued vacation

breaks.meal: 30 minutes (unpaid) for shifts over 6 hours that span 11 am to 2 pm, taken between 11 am and 2 pm; additional meal periods for early/late shifts

source.quote: Work a shift of more than six hours starting before 11 AM AND Continue until 2 PM MUST Have an uninterrupted lunch period of AT LEAST Half an hour between 11 AM and 2 PM

notes.text: Since January 1, 2025, every employer must give 20 hours of paid prenatal personal leave per year, separate from sick leave.

source.quote: on and after January first, two thousand twenty-five, every employer shall be required to provide to its employees twenty hours of paid prenatal personal leave

notes.text: The minimum wage will NOT rise on January 1, 2027: an inflation 'off-ramp' was triggered, so rates stay at $17.00 / $16.00 (home care aides still rise).

source.quote: For 2027, the conditions for one of the off-ramps has been met. As a result, the minimum wage will not receive an inflation-based increase on January 1, 2027

notes.text: Farm workers' overtime threshold dropped to 52 hours a week on January 1, 2026, on its way to 40 hours in 2032.

source.quote: 52 in a calendar week on or after 01/01/2026; 48 in a calendar week on or after 01/01/2028
